composition_label: Guided setup -> Sentiment & prioritization -> Deep research

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in this isolated build directory

input.prerequisites: object of prerequisite identifiers to booleans
input.research_questions: array of {id,topic,question}; topic must have feedback

shared_schema.handoff: Versioned envelope {schema_version,synthetic,stage,input,guided,sentiment}; a shared validator checks exact structure, input validity and recomputes derived contracts before consumption.
shared_schema.validation: Exact field sets, nonblank strings, strict booleans/version, unique row IDs and references, defined references, acyclic dependencies, legal completion, legal severities and claim positions, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Guided -> sentiment: validated completed step IDs gate feedback; progress and prerequisite blockers remain in the final shared output.
Sentiment -> deep: validated ranked issues supply research topics, ordering, priority scores, sentiment labels, issue IDs and onboarding step provenance.
Deep synthesis operates only on prioritized feedback topics and the original validated documents retained in the shared envelope.

behavior.guided: Complete, ready and blocked states; exact missing prerequisites and waiting dependencies; completed/total/fraction progress; empty onboarding has fraction 1.
behavior.sentiment: Published English lexicon mean with match-level contributions, three-token negation and punctuation reset. Unmatched text is neutral with explicit no-coverage label. Severity base plus negative-sentiment bonus yields deterministic ranks; ties by issue ID. Higher severity always outranks lower severity.
behavior.deep: Exact-topic synthesis of supplied structured claims; document-level position counts do not multiply repeated claims. Exact quotes, document IDs and claim indices support audit. Opposed stances flag disagreement. Missing evidence, single-source limitations and supplied questions remain unresolved; no majority vote establishes truth.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout; exit 0 for success, exit 2 for validation, file, encoding or JSON errors.

included: One integrated deterministic pipeline with shared validation
Synthetic fixture data and traceable provenance
Validated stage ordering and tamper detection
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI checks
excluded: Network access, external retrieval or live providers
LLM calls or injected model hooks; none needed for deterministic reference
Factual verification, source credibility inference or question answering
Enterprise authentication, databases, persistence services or UI
General language understanding, sarcasm and multilingual sentiment
